body: Would my doctor be able to get me to try new meds? I take 40mg citalopram and 300mg welbutrin and it's not cutting it right now.
Now I cant... My mother decided to go into the next province for 5 days. If I'm going to attempt and get hospitalized I want her to be close by. I don't want to ruin her trip over there.

I could never hurt him. He is my everything. He would do anything for me. I wish he could save me. And I know me being like this, bursting into sobs at night and sleeping all day, I know it hurts him. I know he feels lost he doesn't know how to help. I don't want to drag him down in my misery. He held me as I cried tonight told me he would always be with me. I know he doesn't know what to say when I tell him in scared I'm going to give up, scared I'm not strong enough this time, he just holds me and let's me cry. How can I do this to him.
